instance-n10000-alpha-4-24: Section IV, p.3 and the abstract: a single random 3-SAT instance, N = 10000 (the text layer prints 10^4 as 104; the abstract says 10000 and Fig. 1 caption repeats it), alpha = 4.24, at the SAT/UNSAT border. Read in context.
instance-verified-satisfiable: Section IV, p.4: the authors state they checked the chosen formula is satisfiable using WalkSAT plus message passing. A stated property of their own test instance; no detail of the run is given, but it is a setup statement.
clause-energy-hamiltonian: Section II, p.2, Eq. (1) and the sentence after it: Ea = 0 if the clause is satisfied, 1 otherwise; the Hamiltonian sums the clause energies and counts violated clauses.
max-3-sat-definition: Section II, p.2: the optimization version (MAX-3-SAT) is stated as finding an assignment that minimizes the number of violated clauses.
linear-classical-schedule: Section III, p.3: linear schedule, fixed DeltaT every delta sweeps, delta = 2 chosen in the experiments. The paper also says DeltaT follows from T0 and the iteration count.
transverse-field-hamiltonian: Section III, p.3, Eq. (4): H_Quantum = H({sigma^z}) - Gamma sum sigma^x, built by the substitution the quote names.
pimc-no-zero-temperature: Section III, p.3: the authors state the principal drawback of the PIMC approach they use, no direct zero-temperature simulation, and name other QMC schemes for that. It is a caveat on their own method (it forces a fixed nonzero T in the QA schedule).
linear-qa-schedule: Section III, p.3: the linear-schedule QA used in Fig. 1 ramps the transverse field between Gamma0 and Gammaf at fixed T. Read in context; the paper then uses linear QA throughout Section IV.
residual-energy-protocol: Section IV, p.4, text for Fig. 1: residual energy is final energy minus known ground-state energy, 50 realizations per point, plus a second average over the P replicas for QA. Basis is setup and definition together; both settled by the paper.
autocorrelation-definition: Section VI, p.6, Eq. (7) and the sentence after it: K(t, tau) defined as the overlap correlation, averaged over realizations and, for QA, over replicas.
autocorrelation-run-setup: Section VI, p.6: results in Figs. 3 and 4 are averaged over 500 runs of 2000 annealing iterations, and over P = 50 replicas for QA.
hybrid-strategy-definition: Section VII, p.8: T is slightly reduced before each field ramp and kept constant during each ramp, giving a linear-schedule CA superposed with QA cycles. The paper names it a hybrid strategy.
hybrid-run-parameters: Section VII, p.8 and Fig. 6 caption: total length 3100 MC iterations, J_Gamma cycled between 0.001 and 5, Tq reduced stepwise from 0.3 to 0.05. Text and caption agree.
longer-schedules-rescaled: Section VII, p.9: longer field-cycling schedules are made by rescaling all ramp durations by a constant factor, stated as the paper's own construction.
open-questions-predictive-theory: Section VIII, p.9: the authors state their work leaves many important questions open and that a predictive theory built on landscape features is still needed. It is an open problem the paper states, not a measured result.
scope-not-performance-focus: Section I, p.1: the main emphasis is stated to be understanding, not performance. Note the paper still reports performance comparisons (Fig. 1); the value only reports the stated emphasis.
scope-aging-not-addressed: Section I, p.1: aging and memory/rejuvenation phenomena will not be addressed directly, stated by the authors. Section VII does mention them by analogy only.
